language.howToChooseYourGradeIntro: Our curriculum Grades K to 6 corresponds with ages:
language.howToChooseYourGradeContent:
It’s very important children start at the right level, have fun in learning and work at their own pace. Please help the children selecting the level that is not too easy, but also not too difficult for them. There are two ways to do this.

  • You can either check the learning goals yourself to determine the correct level for your child(ren).
  • Or you can let the child take several lessons to determine his or her level. For example, if your child has the age of 6, please let him or her take one lesson in grade K, one lesson in grade 1, and one lesson in grade 2 to determine at which level he or she is.

dialog.text: Hello, I am Tim.
Hello, I am Maddy! Welcome to my home. I live on Bikini Atoll. Bikini Atoll is part of an island group called the Marshall islands, which is a part of the USA.
My school is on the island. Every week our teacher gives us some homework. For next week I need to make a presentation about lung diseases.

We all need our lungs to breathe, and lung diseases make it more difficult or sometimes even impossible to breathe. It’s very scary when you can’t breathe! I already know there are five different kind of lung diseases that are common:
Lung cancer is when there are cancer cells growing in someone’s lungs.
Pneunomia is an infection by virusses or bacteria in the lungs.
COPD is when someone's lungs are damaged by bad air, for example from smoking.
Astma is a condition people can have their entire lives, where their airways are easily irritated.
Tuberculosis is when a very dangerous bacteria has infected the lungs.
I sure hope I don’t get a lung disease! Let’s see if we can find out more about this.
